'''3B3-888''', also known as '''7276''', was a [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who served in the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] of [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. When Gunray's forces [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] and occupied the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] responded by massing their own [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|army]] to combat the invaders. 3B3-888 was a part of the force dispatched to eliminate the Gungans, and the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] captured two enemy officers during the resulting [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|battle]]. 3B3-888 was later deactivated, like all other Federation droids on the planet, when the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Naboo was destroyed.

==Biography==
3B3-888<ref name="ccg" /> was a [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]] who served in [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation Viceroy]] [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray's]] [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]].<ref name="tpm" /> In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> Gunray used the forces under his command to [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], as a sign of protest against the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate's]] newly ratified [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|taxation of trade routes]]. In short order, Gunray had his troops [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invade]] Naboo and occupy the planet. 3B3-888 was a part of the force stationed on the planet, under the command of [[OOM-9/Legends|OOM-9]].<ref name="tpm" />

In response to the occupation, a [[Gungan Grand Army/Legends|substantial force]] of the planet's native [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] assembled at the [[Great Grass Plains/Legends|Great Grass Plains]], headed by [[Bombad General/Legends|Bombad General]] [[Jar Jar Binks/Legends|Jar Jar Binks]],<ref name="tpm" /> and [[General/Legends|General]] [[Tobler Ceel/Legends|Tobler Ceel]].<ref name="tpmn">[[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace (novelization)|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'' novelization]]</ref> OOM-9 and a sizable army of [[Droid/Legends|droids]], 3B3-888 included, were sent to meet the Gungans and engage them, resulting in the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of the Great Grass Plains]]. The Gungans were eventually routed, and as they retreated, 3B3-888, aided by several other B1s, captured both Binks and [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Roos Tarpals/Legends|Roos Tarpals]]. Shortly afterward, however, the [[Lucrehulk-class battleship/Legends|Droid Control Ship]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] Naboo and controlling all [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] on the planet surface was destroyed, resulting in the instantaneous deactivation of 3B3-888 and the rest of the Federation force. Naboo's leader, [[Queen/Legends|Queen]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], later captured Gunray and reclaimed possession of the planet.<ref name="tpm" />

==Characteristics==
3B3-888 had [[Color/Legends|white]] plating, black [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]],<ref name="tpm" /> and, like all B1 battle droids, stood 1.91 [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="db" /> 3B3-888 wielded an [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifle]] in combat against the Gungans. The droid also exhibited the ability to capture retreating enemies, which it implemented during the Battle of the Great Grass Plains.<ref name="tpm" />

==Behind the scenes==
3B3-888 made its first appearance in [[George Lucas]]' [[1999]] film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']].<ref name="tpm" /> The character was later identified in the ''[[Theed Palace Limited]]'' expansion set of the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''Star Wars'' Customizable Card Game]].<ref name="ccg" />
